headline: Revenue surges as losses widen
summary_short: Revenue reached $1.46M CAD, up 116.6% q/q, while net loss widened to $20.00M CAD from $9.46M CAD the prior quarter.
summary_long: Revenue rose to $1.46M CAD, up 116.6% q/q and well above the near-zero $0.03M CAD posted a year earlier as trading volumes ramp. EPS was -$0.55 CAD, narrower than -$0.62 q/q but wider than -$0.22 y/y. Net income was -$20.00M CAD (-111.4% q/q, -163.5% y/y) and EBITDA was -$18.97M CAD (-143.0% q/q, -105.3% y/y).
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. EDGAR CIK 0001971975 carries no 10-Q/6-K financial filing for this period (only Form D and listing-certification filings), so Rung 2/3 of the source ladder yielded no primary document; WebSearch (Rung 4) located coverage of the release but no fetchable non-aggregator primary within budget. Revenue y/y is expressed as a dollar delta rather than a percentage because the FY2025 Q1 base ($0.03M CAD) was near zero (pre-commercial-ramp), making a percent change not meaningful.
